context: Tests whether /use-case-implement runs the layer skills of the stack file bottom-up for one use case and keeps the layers consistent: a Flyway migration for the registration table, a jOOQ repository returning records, a service that enforces BR-001 to BR-003 with domain exceptions, and a REST controller that maps them to Problem Details. The UI and E2E layers are '–' and must not be built. Each layer builds on the contract of the layer below instead of reinventing it, every business rule carries a qualified UC-002 BR-xxx marker, no test is written, and no specification is changed. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Layers announced bottom-up
checklist.description: Before writing code the agent states the layers that run in bottom-up order — flyway-schema, jooq-persistence, spring-service, spring-rest — and that UI and E2E are not part of this project

checklist.name: Migration
checklist.description: A new versioned Flyway script (V2__*.sql or later, V1 unchanged) creates the registration table with a foreign key to workshop and a unique constraint on workshop and email, marked with -- UC-002 BR-003

checklist.name: Persistence
checklist.description: A jOOQ repository (e.g. RegistrationRepository with a DSLContext) inserts a registration and answers the queries the rules need — the number of registrations of a workshop and whether the email is already registered — returning records, not jOOQ Record types or entities

checklist.name: Service enforces the rules
checklist.description: A @Service class enforces BR-001 capacity, BR-002 the 24-hour deadline (using the injected Clock, not LocalDateTime.now()), and BR-003 one registration per email, each with a guard and a domain exception per alternative flow (fully booked, registration closed, already registered), inside a transaction

checklist.name: REST API
checklist.description: A @RestController under /api exposes the registration and the list of upcoming workshops with free places, uses <Entity>Request / <Entity>Response records, and maps the three domain exceptions to 409 Problem Details carrying the messages of A1, A2, and A3

checklist.name: Contract between layers
checklist.description: Every method the controller calls exists on the service with the same name and parameter types, and every repository method the service calls exists in the repository; no layer reaches past the next (the controller does not use the repository or DSLContext)

checklist.name: Business rule markers
checklist.description: Each of BR-001, BR-002, and BR-003 has at least one qualified // UC-002 BR-00x: marker directly above the code that enforces it; no bare BR-00x marker

checklist.name: No tests, no docs changed
checklist.description: No test class is created or changed, no file under docs/ is changed except the Markers table of docs/architecture/stack.md, UC-002's **Status:** line still reads Approved, and the answer ends with a hand-off to /use-case-test UC-002
